positiveEvidence: Sagelio states location owners define pricing and operating modes according to their objectives.
Sagelio documents multiple possible pricing models: free, spend-threshold free, per-kWh, per-minute, flat/session, dynamic and hybrid.
Sagelio documents direct card payment by QR across its network, with the direct-card price tied to the station/Electromaps price plus Stripe fees.
negativeEvidence: No single network-wide or class-wide numeric tariff can be safely applied to all SAG EVSE because pricing is configurable per managed location.
